question: By what percentage did the All-India House Price Index increased annually in Q4 FY25, with Kolkata recording the highest price growth and Kochi witnessing a decline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3.1%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** released the **All-India House Price Index (HPI)** for the fourth quarter of the financial year **2024-25 (Q4 FY25)**, which showed an annual growth (year-on-year) of **3.1%**.
 
• This growth rate of **3.1%** in **March 2025** represents a moderation compared to the **4.6%** growth recorded in the corresponding quarter of the previous year (**Q4 FY24**).
 
• Among the major cities tracked, **Kolkata** recorded the highest annual price appreciation at **10.1%**, signaling strong demand in the West Bengal capital.
